info.title: What causes ear pressure
info.subtitle: Common reasons your ears feel full and blocked

rows.title: Eustachian tube
rows.desc: Equalizes middle-ear pressure when it opens

rows.title: Altitude and flying
rows.desc: Swallow, yawn, or chew to open it

rows.title: Congestion
rows.desc: Colds and allergies swell the tube shut

rows.title: Earwax buildup
rows.desc: Trapped wax can cause a plugged feeling

rows.title: When to seek help
rows.desc: Pain, drainage, or fullness over a week
